# FINMA mapping

<!-- Generated by `python -m dora_roi.docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

How the DORA Register of Information (plus the Art. 30 contract assessments and the incident log of this toolkit) covers the outsourcing inventory of FINMA Circular 2018/3 and the critical-function and ICT resilience documentation of FINMA Circular 2023/1, and what a Swiss group has to maintain in addition. *Coverage by design*; the workbench (*Switzerland (FINMA)*) and `roi finma` also measure how complete the data is in a given register. Paraphrased and interpretive – see [ASSUMPTIONS.md](ASSUMPTIONS.md) (A-FINMA-*).

## FINMA Circular 2018/3 – Outsourcing

| ID | Topic | Requirement | Coverage | RoI fields | Art. 30 / incidents | What is missing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FIN-OS-01 | Inventory | Description of each outsourced function | partial | B_06.01 c0030, B_02.02 c0050, B_02.02 c0060 | — | The RoI lists ICT services, not outsourcings in the FINMA sense: flag which arrangements are outsourcings and add non-ICT outsourcings (e.g. cash handling, back office). |
| FIN-OS-02 | Inventory | Service provider (Rz 14) | partial | B_05.01 c0050, B_05.01 c0080, B_05.01 c0010 | — | The inventory covers all significant outsourced functions, including non-ICT ones; the RoI only holds ICT providers. |
| FIN-OS-03 | Inventory | Sub-providers of significant functions (Rz 14) | partial | B_05.02 c0030, B_05.02 c0050, B_05.02 c0060 | — | Covered for ICT services; sub-providers of non-ICT outsourcings are not in the RoI. |
| FIN-OS-04 | Inventory | Service recipient within the group (Rz 14) | partial | B_02.02 c0020, B_04.01 c0020, B_01.02 c0010 | — | Swiss group entities are outside the DORA scope: add them to B_01.02 for the group view and mark them as outside the DORA reporting scope (this page, or `roi export --exclude-entity`) so the xBRL-CSV package leaves them out. |
| FIN-OS-05 | Inventory | Responsible person or unit in the bank | none | — | — | Not part of the RoI. Maintain a business owner / responsible unit per arrangement. |
| FIN-OS-06 | Definitions / inventory | Assessment whether the outsourced function is significant | partial | B_06.01 c0050, B_06.01 c0060 | — | DORA 'critical or important function' and FINMA 'significant function' are similar but not identical: record the FINMA significance assessment separately where it differs. |
| FIN-OS-07 | Inventory / contract | Term and notice periods – evidence for an orderly change of provider (Rz 18–18.1) | partial | B_02.02 c0070, B_02.02 c0080, B_02.02 c0100, B_02.02 c0110 | — | Not an inventory or minimum contract requirement (Rz 14, 32–35); the dates support the orderly change of provider or insourcing (Rz 18–18.1). |
| FIN-OS-08 | Selection, instruction and monitoring | Due diligence before selection and ongoing monitoring of the provider | partial | B_07.01 c0070 | — | Only the last audit date is in the RoI. Keep due-diligence and monitoring evidence (date, result, owner). |
| FIN-OS-09 | Security | Contractual security requirements and contingency framework (Rz 24–25) | partial | B_02.02 c0170 | `30.2.c` | Data sensitivity and the Art. 30(2)(c) clause cover security in general. Critical data held abroad and its confidentiality are 2023/1 topics (Rz 79, 82); bank-client confidentiality follows from the Banking Act, not from 2018/3. |
| FIN-OS-10 | Security | Business continuity of outsourced significant functions | partial | B_06.01 c0080, B_06.01 c0090 | `30.3.c` | RTO/RPO and the contract clause on tested contingency plans are covered; keep the provider's BCP test results. |
| FIN-OS-11 | Audit and supervision | Audit and information rights for the bank, its audit firm and FINMA | partial | — | `30.3.e.i`, `30.3.e.iii` | The Art. 30(3)(e) clauses grant rights to the 'competent authority' (an EU authority): check that FINMA and the bank's audit firm are named explicitly. |
| FIN-OS-12 | Outsourcing abroad | Abroad: enforceable audit rights, restructuring/resolution, access to data from Switzerland | partial | B_02.02 c0120, B_02.02 c0130, B_02.02 c0150 | `30.2.d`, `30.3.e.i` | Governing law and locations are in the RoI; document that information needed for restructuring or resolution remains accessible from Switzerland. |
| FIN-OS-13 | Contract | Agreement in writing or text form; sub-outsourcing; termination (Rz 32–35) | partial | B_07.01 c0080 | `30.1`, `30.2.a.2`, `30.2.h`, `30.3.f.i`, `30.3.f.ii` | Largely covered by the Art. 30 checklist. Sub-outsourcing: the company must be informed early about the use or replacement of subcontractors and be able to terminate (Rz 33 – no prior consent since the 2020 amendment); internal approval procedures and signing powers (Rz 35) are outside the RoI. |
| FIN-OS-14 | Intra-group outsourcing | Intra-group outsourcings identified (Rz 14) | partial | B_03.03 c0020, B_02.03 c0020 | — | Covered for ICT services between DORA entities; intra-group outsourcings of Swiss entities and non-ICT outsourcings must be added. |

## FINMA Circular 2023/1 – Operational risks and resilience

| ID | Topic | Requirement | Coverage | RoI fields | Art. 30 / incidents | What is missing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FIN-OR-01 | Operational resilience | Inventory of critical functions (Rz 14–16, 107) | partial | B_06.01 c0010, B_06.01 c0030, B_06.01 c0050 | — | FINMA critical functions (disruption would jeopardise the institution's continuation or its role on the financial market) are a much narrower set than DORA critical or important functions – typically a few, top-down (Guidance 05/2025 §3.1): map them explicitly, with their dependencies (Rz 107). |
| FIN-OR-02 | Operational resilience | Tolerance for disruption per critical function (Rz 17) | none | — | — | A tolerance for disruption is the extent (e.g. duration or expected damage) of a disruption the institution is willing to accept, set by the executive board irrespective of its ability to recover; RTO/RPO are not evidence of it (Guidance 05/2025 §3.2). Define tolerances per FINMA critical function. |
| FIN-OR-03 | Operational resilience | Mapping of critical functions to resources, incl. third parties | partial | B_02.02 c0050, B_02.02 c0030, B_05.02 c0030 | — | Third-party dependencies are mapped; add people, premises, internal IT and data. |
| FIN-OR-04 | ICT risk management | ICT inventory with dependencies on third parties | partial | B_02.02 c0060, B_05.02 c0050 | — | Covers ICT services bought from third parties, not the bank's own ICT assets. |
| FIN-OR-05 | Critical data | Critical data: location and protection, also at third parties | partial | B_02.02 c0140, B_02.02 c0150, B_02.02 c0160, B_02.02 c0170 | — | Storage location and sensitivity are reported per service; identify which data is critical in the FINMA sense. |
| FIN-OR-06 | Business continuity management | Business impact analysis, recovery objectives and tested plans | partial | B_06.01 c0080, B_06.01 c0090, B_06.01 c0100 | `30.3.c` | Keep the BIA and test evidence; the RoI only holds the resulting RTO/RPO and impact. |
| FIN-OR-07 | ICT / cyber incident management | Incident management and reporting of cyber attacks to FINMA | partial | — | incident log | The incident log covers the DORA classification and deadlines, which are no evidence of FINMA materiality. FINMA: significant ICT incidents and incidents involving critical data without delay (Rz 60, 81); cyber attacks with a preliminary notification within 24 hours and a report within 72 hours, then a root cause analysis (Rz 68; Guidance 05/2020, 03/2024; FINMASA Art. 29(2)) – track them separately. |
| FIN-OR-08 | Operational resilience | Substitutability and exit for critical third-party dependencies | partial | B_07.01 c0050, B_07.01 c0080, B_07.01 c0110 | `30.3.f.i` | Substitutability and exit plans are reported (2018/3 Rz 18–18.1; 2023/1 Rz 88, 110); test them in severe but plausible scenarios. |
| FIN-OR-09 | Operational resilience | Scenario testing of operational resilience | none | — | — | Not part of the RoI. Plan and document severe but plausible scenario tests per critical function. |
| FIN-OR-10 | ICT risk management | Contractual security requirements for ICT providers | partial | — | `30.2.c`, `30.3.c`, `30.2.i` | Evidenced by the Art. 30 clauses on data security, security measures and training (2018/3 Rz 24; 2023/1 Rz 82, 85 – RTO/RPO agreed with providers). |

**24 requirements:** 0 fully, 21 partially and 3 not covered by design.
